fix_description: The search/replace engine compares the file name and the search pattern code-point-for-code-point (via std::regex / std::wregex) without any Unicode normalization, so a decomposed (NFD) 'й' (U+0438 + U+0306) never matches a composed (NFC) pattern, and a non-breaking space (U+00A0) never matches a normal space. Fix by normalizing both the source string and the search term to a canonical form before matching (e.g. call the Win32 NormalizeString with NormalizationC / NormalizationKC in CPowerRenameRegEx::Replace before invoking regex_search/regex_replace), and map the results back to the original string so the actual bytes on disk are preserved when renaming. This makes NFC and NFD representations, and compatibility whitespace such as NBSP, compare equal.
